messages:
oncall-bot: PAGED sasha — severity: SEV2. Detected increase in 5xx for eu-west canary after tonight's blue/green switch. Traffic shift ~30% -> 60% over last 6 mins. Alerting on error-rate and latency. Logs: `gateway: 502 from runtime-proxy, kv-cache misses spiking`

sasha: i'm on it. what changed in the rollout? 

kevin: pushed the regional weight changes and the new batching config at ~1918765200. no model change. just routing weight flip + new batching window (10ms -> 50ms) to improve throughput.

elena: seeing a mismatch between edge route tags and region metadata. some instances in eu-west still have old env tag -> they were excluded from the new kernel selection, so requests got routed to incompatible instances. example trace: 
```
RequestID: r-3a9f
Route: eu-west/canary
Instance: gpu-12-oldtag
Error: kernel-mismatch-exec-failure

Stack: runtime/proxy -> router:failed-to-accept -> runtime:drop(502)
```

sasha: thanks. can we stop the shift? revert weights to previous blue values?

kevin: yes. i'm reverting the region weights to 30% canary -> 0% immediately. doing weight rollback now. will also flip the kill-switch flag for the canary in eu-west if rollback doesn't stabilize.

matt: @sasha / @kevin note — customer-impact: some mid-tier customers in EU are seeing generation failures and elevated latency, fallback to smaller model sometimes happening, estimated affected sessions ~1.2k in last 10m. CS alerted.

oncall-bot: SCHEDULED ACTION: rolling back traffic weights to previous baseline. Initiated by kevin at 1918765565.

kevin: weights rolled back at 1918765565. verifying traffic.

elena: after rollback, 5xx rate dropped by ~70% in 2m. latency trending down. still seeing a handful of errors from older instances trying to accept reqs. I recommend a targeted kill-switch on the canary feature flag for eu-west until we reconcile tags.

sasha: agreed. enabling kill-switch now (feature.flag.canary_eu = OFF). toggling at 1918765720.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by sasha. On-call shift started.

kevin: kill-switch toggled. reaffirming: no deploys while we reconcile tags. going to run a quick inventory: `./tools/node-tag-check --region eu-west --tag release-2026-03` and then roll nodes that don't match.

elena: running the check now, returns 8 nodes with stale tags out of 72 in eu-west. pushing a node drain/roll plan. schedule: drain small batches (2 nodes) to avoid capacity cliffs.

matt: customer comms: CS drafted a short note for impacted customers, waiting on percentage and ETA before broadcast. recommend 'degraded generation' language and ETA 60-90m.

sasha: handoff: i'll continue incident until 1918766200 then hand to kevin for remediation windows. sasha -> kevin oncall handoff at 1918766200.

kevin: ack. i'll run node rolls and monitor. will open a followup thread for the postmortem once stable.

elena: monitoring: 5xx is down to baseline, but throughput still a touch lower due to reduced canary capacity. keeping alert thresholds tight for next 45m.

matt: moving to SEV2 and creating a customer-impact slice for billing to track any quota/regret adjustments.

sasha: final notes before handoff: cause appears to be route tag drift causing kernel-selection mismatch after weight flip. immediate mitigations: rollback weights, toggle kill-switch, node tag reconciliation + rolling nodes. next steps: post-incident remediation to harden rollout checks (pre-flight compatibility check, gating on tag sync).

kevin: opening a quick JIRA for rollout-safeguards and linking nodes list.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder — sasha handing incident to kevin at 1918766200.

kevin: taking over. I'll post status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
